messages:
alex_ops: Heads-up: eu-central-1 warm pool unexpectedly dropped to ~63% this morning. Node-agent logs show `keystore: Decrypt AccessDenied` and some TLS handshake reset errors right after the SNI inspection CA roll at 04:15 UTC.

sophie_infra: timeline? any recent KMS rotation + FW change overlap?

alex_ops: yes — KMS key rotation completed 04:10, and network/security pushed a new SNI appliance config 04:15 that swapped the inspection cert chain. First failures at 04:18. Sample log: `2026-06-01T04:18:24Z node-agent error keystore.Decrypt AccessDenied principal=arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/warmup-provisioner req=rr-42`

mike_sre: saw mixed responses: some 403, some 502, and ~40s window with almost no CloudTrail KMS events for keystore decrypts. That missing audit window is worrying.

toni_security: I pushed the new CA because the old vendor cert expired. The inspect appliance does TLS rewrap and, on a subset of flows, dropped client cert info when CRL checks timed out. That would explain both auth failures and missing audit lines.

sophie_infra: immediate mitigation: can we bypass inspection for keystore host and temporarily allow the legacy provisioning role for bootstraps?

toni_security: adding an allow rule now: `allow tcp 443 from eu-warm-pool-cidrs to keystore.internal:443 bypass-inspection=true comment:"temp keystore bypass"`

infra-bot: infra action: applied firewall allow rule in eu-central-1 (ruleset v2026.06.01.07). Propagation ~60s.

sophie_infra: also seeing NAT ephemeral port pressure — retries from failed bootstraps consumed ports. I'll spin up an extra NAT and widen node port range to avoid a repeat.

infra-bot: infra action: created NAT gateway nat-0beefed and applied sysctl change net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=\"10240 65535\" to warm-pool autoscale group (propagation ~40s).

mike_sre: after bypass + NAT scale, warm pool rejoined: 63% -> 96% in 7m. A handful of nodes still marked reprovision.

alex_ops: upload pcap + tcpdump to s3://infra-dumps/eu-central-1/1799999012/pcap.tar.gz for the incident.

infra-bot: upload complete: s3://infra-dumps/eu-central-1/1799999012/pcap.tar.gz

toni_security: filing SC-898: root cause appears to be TLS rewrap with CRL timeouts removing client cert metadata. Remediation: (1) exclude keystore path from inline rewrap, (2) add CRL fallback and fail-open for inspection on internal names, (3) test new CA in staging with a keystore mutual-TLS canary before prod rollout.

sophie_infra: follow-ups for infra: (A) add a preflight check to keystore rollouts that validates mutual TLS through any inspection devices, (B) add an alert when warm-pool health <85% and ephemeral ports > 90% usage, (C) create a short synthetic that exercises provisioning under SNI rewrap to catch cert-stripping regressions.

mike_sre: add runbook step: when warm-pool <85% mark, temporarily allow keystore bypass and scale NAT; add owner to triage. I'll write the runbook entry now.

toni_security: one more note on audit gap: the inspection device can act as a TLS terminator which prevents the keystore-proxy from seeing original client certs and sometimes collapses multiple rapid retries into fewer upstream requests, giving the appearance of missing CloudTrail lines. We'll add instrumentation to the proxy to emit a local audit whenever it receives a rewrapped connection.

alex_ops: created incident INC-7890 with artifacts and assigned postmortem. Will include cost calc for NAT pre-scale and an appendix on change sequencing (KMS rotate then cert roll) to avoid overlaps.

mike_sre: scheduling 45m postmortem in #eng-sre in 30m. Owners: runbook (mike_sre), infra preflight (sophie_infra), security CA process (toni_security).

toni_security: temporary IAM allowance applied for `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/warmup-provisioner` for 3h to drain the backlog. Policy snippet (temp): `{"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456:role/warmup-provisioner"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt"]}]}`. Will remove after backlog cleared and audit verified.

sophie_infra: thanks all. Once postmortem lands we'll decide whether to permanently exempt keystore prefixes or require staging-keystore-canary gating for any inspection CA roll.

mike_sre: closing loop when postmortem doc is ready. Good catch and quick work everyone. :white_check_mark:
